newsitem.title: USA: SyQuest to buy controlling stake in Nomai.
newsitem.headline: SyQuest to buy controlling stake in Nomai.

text.p: SyQuest Technology said it signed a letter of intent to buy controlling interest in Nomai S.A., A french manufacturer of removable hard drives and cartridges.
Under terms of the agreement, SyQuest would buy two thirds of the company's outstanding capital stock from Marc and Herve Frouin in exchange for about 3.4 million shares of SyQuest stock.
SyQuest said it would then seek approval to make a tender offer for the remaining Nomai shares held by the French public.
It said it expects to close the acquisition of Frouins' shares in early 1997, and complete the tender offer shortly thereafter.
